tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP is ideal for contrastive analysis as it provides consistent, game-theoretic feature importance across classes. LIME helps interpret the local behavior of the model around the top-1 prediction. Integrated Gradients offer a baseline-aware, smooth attribution method, especially useful in tabular data with non-linear relationships. Sensitivity analysis adds robustness by measuring how much prediction probability shifts when features are ablated, confirming causality in feature influence.
